summary: Restoration pledges include reaching a 12.9% national forest-cover level by 2030, identifying 9,700 ha for afforestation by then, and separately committing to 25,000 ha of sustainable afforestation/reforestation and 50,000 ha of afforestation/reforestation by 2035, plus restoring 4,000 ha of degraded agricultural land. The 12.9% level is below the 2022 mapped forest share of 21.7%; the afforestation areas equal about 1.5%, 3.9%, and 7.7% of current forest, respectively. Agriculture targets cover 50,000 ha under improved irrigation (3.1% of current agricultural land), 10% fertilizer replacement, elimination of open residue burning through a 100% emissions reduction, and 100 smart farms by 2035. Cross-sector commitments set 20% and 40% degraded-forest management/restoration thresholds by 2035, 1.5% soil-organic-carbon growth by 2040 versus 2015, and flood protection in 50% of priority river basins. Conservation also targets a 1.4 GFSI natural-resources resilience index score.
